# Pre-processing Pipeline — Stem Cell Niche RCTD Deconvolution

## Purpose

**Reproducibility record** for the RCTD-deconvolved stem cell niche spatial object
(`niche_object_8um_with_DR_RCTD.RDS`) — the object behind Figure 6's deconvolution
panels. Included via a `{r child=...}` chunk in the deconvolution figure script.

**All chunks are `eval = FALSE`** — code-of-record, curated from the authoritative
source notebooks `04_RCTD_Deconvolution_StemCellNiche_8um.Rmd` (in
`DR_scRNA_001/analysis/`) and `Stem_Cell_Niche_Analysis_8um.Rmd` /
`Swap_LowRes_to_HiRes_Images.Rmd` (in `DR_Visium_HD_analysis_Jan_26/`). Not
re-run at figure time; the figure reads the frozen RDS + hi-res PNGs. To rebuild,
run the stages below in order on a compute node.

### Object build DAG

```
final_analysis_object.RDS (8um Visium HD, all spots)
   │
   ▼  Stem_Cell_Niche_Analysis_8um.Rmd (DR_Visium_HD_analysis_Jan_26/)
   │  assigns stem_niche_zone via classify_niche_zone():
   │  Stem_cell | Immediate_periphery | Outside_niche | No_tissue
   ▼
final_analysis_object_8um_with_stem_niche.RDS
   │
   ▼  04_RCTD_Deconvolution_StemCellNiche_8um.Rmd (DR_scRNA_001/analysis/)
   │  (1) subset spots to stem_niche_zone %in% c("Stem_cell","Immediate_periphery")
   │  (2) build RCTD reference from DR26001_v2_annotated_seurat_singlets.rds,
   │      fine-grained `cell_type` (min 25 cells/type; excludes Unknown/
   │      Unassigned/Doublet/low-quality/Mid-villus enterocytes/Brunner's gland)
   │  (3) run.RCTD(doublet_mode = "doublet", UMI_min = 50) per sample
   │  (4) merge per-sample results -> DR_RCTD_* proportion + dominant_celltype
   │      + spot_class columns
   ▼
niche_object_8um_with_DR_RCTD.RDS
   │
   ▼  Swap_LowRes_to_HiRes_Images.Rmd technique (DR_Visium_HD_analysis_Jan_26/),
   │  applied inline in 13/14_RCTD_HiRes_Plots_*.Rmd (DR_scRNA_001/analysis/):
   │  swap each image slot's low-res raster for Space Ranger's
   │  tissue_hires_image.png; point scale.factors$lowres at scale.factors$hires
   │  so every existing pt.size.factor call renders against the hi-res image
   │  unchanged.
   ▼
Figure 6 deconvolution panels (this figure)
```

RCTD reference uses the fine-grained `cell_type` column (not `broad_cell_type`) —
this is a stem-cell-niche-specific choice (04 differs from notebooks 10/11's
`broad_cell_type` reference), so subtypes like GREM1+/FOXL1+ fibroblasts and
resident/monocyte-derived/proliferating macrophages stay distinct in the niche
deconvolution.

## Stage 1 — Assign niche zones (`Stem_Cell_Niche_Analysis_8um.Rmd`)

```{r stage1-niche-zones, eval=FALSE}
# Distance to the nearest stem-cell-dominant bin, then zone assignment. The niche is
# the stem-cell bins plus their immediate periphery: within 3 bin widths (≤ 24 µm).
# classify_niche_zone() is defined in Preprocessing_VisiumHD_8um_final.Rmd, Stage 7.
merged.object$stem_niche_zone <- classify_niche_zone(...)  # Stem_cell | Immediate_periphery | Outside_niche
saveRDS(merged.object, "output_8um/RDS-files/final_analysis_object_8um_with_stem_niche.RDS")
```

## Stage 2 — Build RCTD reference + run per sample (`04_RCTD_Deconvolution_StemCellNiche_8um.Rmd`)

```{r stage2-rctd, eval=FALSE}
merged.object <- readRDS("output_8um/RDS-files/final_analysis_object_8um_with_stem_niche.RDS")
niche_object  <- merged.object[, !is.na(merged.object$stem_niche_zone) &
                                  merged.object$stem_niche_zone %in%
                                  c("Stem_cell", "Immediate_periphery")]

sc_ref <- readRDS("outputs/DR26001_v2_annotated_seurat_singlets.rds")

REMOVE_LABELS <- c("Unknown", "Unassigned", "Doublet",
                   "High-mitochondrial/low-quality cells",
                   "Low-confidence sparse-marker myeloid-like cells",
                   "Transcriptionally diffuse low-confidence cells",
                   "Mid-villus enterocytes", "Mid villus enterocyte-2",
                   "Regenerative Brunners gland-like epithelial cells")
MIN_CELLS_PER_CT <- 25

ref_celltypes <- factor(sc_ref$cell_type)
valid_cts <- names(table(ref_celltypes))[table(ref_celltypes) >= MIN_CELLS_PER_CT &
                                          !names(table(ref_celltypes)) %in% REMOVE_LABELS]
ref_rctd <- Reference(counts = round(GetAssayData(sc_ref, layer = "counts")),
                      cell_types = droplevels(ref_celltypes[ref_celltypes %in% valid_cts]),
                      nUMI = colSums(...))

# Per sample: SpatialRNA() from tissue coordinates + counts, then
for (img in Images(niche_object)) {
  rctd <- create.RCTD(spatial_rctd, ref_rctd, max_cores = 1, UMI_min = 50)
  rctd <- run.RCTD(rctd, doublet_mode = "doublet")
  saveRDS(rctd, paste0("rctd_niche_result_", img, ".RDS"))
}

# Merge per-sample weights -> DR_RCTD_<celltype> proportion columns,
# DR_RCTD_dominant_celltype, DR_RCTD_spot_class
saveRDS(niche_object, "outputs/RCTD/8um_stem_niche/RDS-files/niche_object_8um_with_DR_RCTD.RDS")
```

## Stage 3 — Hi-res image swap (applied inline in the figure script)

```{r stage3-hires-swap, eval=FALSE}
# For each image slot (e.g. "Duodenum.3.008um"), replace the low-res raster with
# Space Ranger's tissue_hires_image.png and point scale.factors$lowres at the
# hi-res value, so pt.size.factor-based plotting calls need no changes.
img <- niche_object@images[[slot_name]]
img@image <- png::readPNG(hires_png_path)
img@scale.factors$lowres <- img@scale.factors$hires
niche_object@images[[slot_name]] <- img
```

This is the canonical fine-`cell_type` RCTD deconvolution for the stem cell
niche; the all-spots datasets (notebooks 10/11) use a separate `broad_cell_type`
reference and are not part of this figure.
